title: WTAF
tagline: AI Curated meme-coin battle royale where the rules of elimination are complete BS
description:
A meme-coin launchpad in the style of a battle royale, where an AI game master determines the rules for each round. As meme-coins are eliminated from the round their tokens are burnt to 0. Winner is the last meme-standing.

You've heard of survival of the fittest; this meme battle is survival of the shittest! Let the games begin.
how_its_made:
How It's Made: Assembling the WTAF.fun Machine

"WTAF.fun" aims to bring chaos and memes to Web3 using AI-powered, community-driven token battles. To build this machine, we're relying on a mix of established and emerging technologies:

Foundation: Monorepo with pnpm, Hardhat for smart contracts, Next.js with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI for the front-end.

Token Deployment: Open Zeppelin for quick and easy ERC-20 deployments.

AI Rule Generation: OpenAPI for random and unpredictable battle rules (we're aiming for maximum "WTF").

Smart Contracts: Solidity for the core BattleRoyale logic (token staking, rule evaluation, burning, payouts).

Deployment: Using Open Zeppelin integration to get the project up and running quickly.

We're anticipating challenges in wrangling the AI, and we'll be sure to look for clever hacks to ensure that we can put out a project quickly. We believe that Open Zeppelin will help get this project off the ground as soon as possible. We will then connect the AI and run our custom algorithms.
We can't wait to show you what we've created.
